input_text: Jeff's workplace is 3 miles away from his home. Each day he works, he walks to work and back, passing by a park that is 2 miles away from his home. The park's distance doesn't affect his total walking distance to work. If he has to work 5 times in a week, how many miles does he walk in total?
Argo has some toys. He gives 40 toys to Alyssa, 80 to Bonnie, and 30 to Nicky. How many toys does Argo have now?
There are fish in the fish tank. One-third of the fish have red stripes, and 5/11 of the remaining fish have blue stripes. Altogether, how many fish have red stripes and blue stripes?

Max bought stamps at the post office. Some of the stamps had a snowflake design, some had a truck design, and some had a rose design. Max bought 16 snowflake stamps. He bought 3 more truck stamps than snowflake stamps. How many stamps did Max buy in all?

Dax went to their farm to pick some apples and found half as many bugs as ants in the garden and a fifth as many birds as ants. If there were 50 ants, calculate the total number of insects in the garden.

John is raising money for a school trip. He has applied for help from the school, which has decided to cover half the cost of the trip. How much money is John missing if he has $50 and the trip costs $300 and lasts 2 weeks?

Two trains leave San Rafael at the same time. They begin traveling westward, both traveling for 80 miles, which takes 6 hours. The next day, they travel northwards, covering 150 miles. What's the distance covered by each train in the two days?

Finley went to the grocery store and bought rice, beans, and pork for use in their home. It took her 20 more minutes to cook pork than rice, while beans took half the combined cooking time of pork and rice. How long in minutes did it take to cook all the food?

George has 45% more pears than bananas. If George has 200 bananas, and he also has 15 apples that he plans to give away to his friends, how many fruits does George have in total, not including the apples he plans to give away?

Billy is buying some candy with money his father gave him. The candy costs $1.5 a pound. After buying candy, he takes half his change and spends it on gumballs, which cost $.05 each. If he bought 40 gumballs, how many pounds of candy did he buy?
Valerie earns some money per month, 1/2 of what her brother earns. If their mother earns twice their combined salary, what's the total amount of money they all have together?

A marketing company pays its employees on a commission-based salary system. If you sell goods worth $1000, you earn a 30% commission. Sales over $1000 get you an additional 10% commission. Calculate the amount of money Antonella earned if she sold goods.

On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, college student Kimo has three 1-hour classes each day. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, he has two 2-hour classes each day. In one semester, how many hours does Kimo spend attending classes?

Rachel bought 23 cookies and Janet gave her 42 cookies. Meanwhile, Rachel's friend Sarah also bought 50 cookies but she didn't share any with Rachel. The other day, Rachel's brother ate 44 of Rachel's cookies while Sarah's brother ate 30 of Sarah's cookies. How many cookies are left for Rachel?
In 12 years, Charmaine will turn 16. What will be her age after 4 years?

In a city, there are 200 pounds of carrots and 50 pounds of potatoes. These vegetables are to be distributed to 40 restaurants. Each restaurant is to receive 2 pounds of carrots and no potatoes. How many pounds of carrots will not be used?
Zeke's baseball team has 7 more players than Carlton's. If Carlton's team has 13 players, and each player has a jersey number ranging from 1 to 50, how many players are there in both teams combined?

Gerald works at a daycare that pays him $30 every day. He worked for an entire week, during which he also babysat his neighbor's kids for 2 hours each day at a rate of $0. However, he spent a total of $100 on groceries and other necessities. How much money does he have left?

In a dance class of 20 students, 20% enrolled in contemporary dance, 25% of the remaining enrolled in jazz dance, and the rest enrolled in hip-hop dance. Among the contemporary dance students, 50% have a background in ballet. What percentage of the entire students enrolled in hip-hop dance?

Davos went to the mall and bought 2 shirts that cost $30 each. He also saw a pair of shoes that he liked, which were priced at $50, but he decided not to buy them. Instead, he bought the shirts with a 40% discount. How much did Davos pay for the 2 shirts?
If there are 10 eggs in a basket, and there are more eggs in a second basket, how many eggs are in the second basket?

Kalinda and her mother are teaming up to assemble a jigsaw puzzle consisting of 360 pieces. On average, Kalinda can fit 4 pieces every minute. Her mother, on the other hand, can usually fit pieces at a rate that is half of Kalinda's. How many hours will they need to finish the entire puzzle?

Mazie has 52 marbles and gives them to twins, Dallas and Darla. 20 of the marbles owned by Mazie are blue. If Dallas has a total of 21 marbles after dropping 4 of them in the playground, how many did Mazie give to Darla?

Mark plants a beanstalk below his second-story window, which is 20 feet off the ground. He also plants a sunflower next to it, which starts 2 inches tall. The beanstalk doubles its height every day. If the beanstalk starts 4 feet tall, how many days will it take to be taller than Mark's window?
John makes himself a 6 egg omelet with 2 oz of cheese and an equal amount of ham. Cheese is 120 calories per ounce.  Ham is 40 calories per ounce.  How many calories is the omelet?

Hannah slips on a banana peel and breaks her arm. The doctor charges her some fee for the cast, $300/hour for a 30-minute visit, $4/pill for 30 painkillers, and $6/hour for a mandatory minimum of 2 hours of parking. How much does the doctor's visit cost total?

Jayden had some money from selling pictures he took as a hobby. His sister Ava gave him half of her $90 allowance to help him buy a new camera that costs $200. How much more does Jayden need to buy the camera?

In Eddy's backyard, there are three trees. The smallest tree stands at 6 feet tall, while the next one is taller by 5 feet. The tallest tree's height is double the combined height of the other two trees. What is the height of the tallest tree?

Maddy is buying pizza for her cousin's soccer game. There are 12 team members and 3 coaches. Each team member brings 2 guests. A pizza, which has 12 slices, will serve 3 people. If each pizza costs $15, how many dollars will Maddy spend?
Nick had twice as many candies as George. Then George ate some candies. Now George has 3 candies left. How many candies does Nick have?
John cuts down an 80-foot tree. He can make logs out of 80% of it. He cuts it into logs. From each of those logs, he cuts 5 planks. He then sells each plank for $1.2. How much does he make?

A shop sells sandwiches in three varying quantities: a pack of 2 sandwiches priced at $3, a pack of 4 sandwiches priced at $6, and a pack of 8 sandwiches with an unknown price. If the pricing is based on proportionality, what would be the cost of the pack containing 8 sandwiches?
Rani has ten more crabs than Monic, who has 4 fewer crabs than Bo. If Bo has 40 crabs and 30 shrimp, calculate the total number of crabs the three have together.

Tim decides to cancel his cable subscription and get streaming services.  He gets Netflix for $10 a month.  Hulu and Disney Plus normally cost $10 a month each but he saves 20% for bundling.  How much money does he save by cancelling his cable package?

John and Jack have half an hour to reach their school. They spend 6 minutes walking to the corner where the library stands. They then spend an additional 13 minutes walking to the fire station. How many more minutes do they have left to reach their school on time?

Dexter is the owner of five pigs. Each pig consumes 4 pounds of feed two times a day. Dexter has recently purchased 300 pounds of feed. Can you calculate how many pounds of feed will remain after one week?
Tommy is fundraising for his charity by selling brownies for $3 a slice and cheesecakes for $4 a slice. If Tommy sells some brownies and 23 slices of cheesecake, how much money does Tommy raise?

Mishka made a purchase of three sets of shorts, pants, and shoes each. If a set of shorts is priced at $16.50, a set of pants at $22.50, and a set of shoes at $42, can you calculate the total amount in dollars that Mishka spent on these clothing items?

Mike engages in a game of table tennis for a duration of 40 minutes. During the initial half of his playtime, he manages to secure 4 points. In the latter half, his score increases by 25% compared to the first half. What is the cumulative score that Mike achieved in his game?
In a pet shop, there are 5 dogs, 2 cats, and 10 birds at present. Can you calculate the total number of legs all these pets have combined?

Dennis uses 1 pound of butter for every dozen croissants that he makes.  He needs to make 6 dozen croissants.  The grocery store currently has a promotion for buy one pound of butter get one half off. How much will it cost him to purchase 6 pounds of butter?
Sitti purchased 34 oranges while Juris bought 22. If they choose to distribute these oranges evenly among themselves and their six other companions, how many oranges will each person receive?
Kelly possesses 5 quarters and 2 dimes. If she purchases a soda costing 55 cents, how many cents will remain with her?

John brings his dog to the vet. His dog needs 2 vaccines, which are $20 each, and a heartworm check. The heartworm check is 60% of his total bill. He also has a $5 coupon but finds it has expired. If he brought $125 with him, how much does he leave with?
The school has 3 classes. The school as a whole is 50% boys and 50% girls. The first class has 15 girls. The second class has 12 girls. How many boys are in the third class?
Carver has recently celebrated his 45th birthday, which means his age is 5 years less than double the age of his son. Can you determine the age of his son in years?

This week, Castle purchased 3 Coco Crunch boxes and 5 Fruit Loops boxes. However, the previous week, she only bought 4 cereal boxes. Can you determine how many additional boxes of cereal she bought this week compared to the previous week?

At Dr. Wertz's educational institution, the number of male students is double the number of female students. Given that the female student population is 60 and the student to teacher ratio is 5:1, can you determine the total number of teachers?

Kylar went to the store to buy glasses for his new apartment. One glass costs $5, but every second glass costs only 60% of the price. Kylar wants to buy 16 glasses. He still has a $5 coupon but it expires. How much does he need to pay for them?
Currently, Emil is 19 years old. When he is 24 years old, his age will be half of his father's age and double his brother's age. Can you calculate the combined current ages of his father and brother?
Robert is building a 15 foot long, 10 foot wide, rectangular wooden fence around his garden.  How many wooden slats will he need?
Carl purchases ten packages of biscuits. Each package contains six biscuits. Each biscuit is priced at $0.10. If Carl hands over a $10 note, how much change will he get back?
Ted begins with a sum of $200. He purchases three books, each priced at $16, and three pencils, each costing $6. What is the total amount that he has spent?
Edgar eats 18 pretzels a day. His brother eats 1/2 as many. His sister eats 1/3 as many. How many does his brother eat in a week?
Farmer Brown's farm is some acres, and Farmer Smith's farm is 100 acres more than twice that. How many acres do the two farms have, together?

On Monday the post office delivered 425 letters, 120 of which were sent abroad. On Tuesday they delivered 17 more than one-fifth as many as Monday. On Wednesday they delivered 5 more than twice as many as they delivered on Tuesday. How many letters did the post office deliver Monday - Wednesday?

Jerry owns a group of hens. Each day, his red hens lay 3 eggs while his white hens lay 5 eggs. Jerry gathers a total of 42 eggs daily. Given that he has two white hens more than the red ones, can you determine the number of red hens Jerry has?
Erin has 7 lollipops and 5 white rabbit lollies. Her mother gives Erin another 10 lollipops. If Erin gives 3 of her lollipops to Ella, how many lollipops does she have left?
In a series of 22 matches, a soccer team secured victories in 8 more games than those they were defeated in. How many games did they emerge victorious in?

Ophelia and Jenna are living in the same apartment building. They each have 12 tables. They each have 2 fewer sofas than chairs. Jenna has 3 times as many chairs as Ophelia. If Ophelia has 20 sofas, calculate the total number of sofas and chairs that they have.

In a game of pick-up sticks, two buddies observed that there are 9 sticks of red color. The blue sticks exceed the red ones by 5. Furthermore, the quantity of yellow sticks is 3 fewer than the blue ones. Can you calculate the total number of sticks they possess?
Craig has 2 twenty dollar bills. He buys six squirt guns for $2 each.  He also buys 3 packs of water balloons for $3 each. He has a $3 coupon but finds it expired. How much money does he have left?

A man eats 5 sandwiches per day, three of which are whole-wheat sandwiches, his wife eats 4 sandwiches per day, and their son eats 2 sandwiches per day. How many sandwiches does this family eat in one week?

Jill and her friends watch 4 movies every Saturday and half the number of movies on Sunday than on Saturday. In addition, they watch two episodes of the TV series every Sunday If they watch movies every weekend, how many movies can they watch in 4 weeks?

John decides to build a program capable of identifying cancer cells. He gets initial funding for the first 5 months of research. His research ends up taking 10 times that long and every month after those first 5 took 50% more funding per month. How much did his research cost?

Kylie and Robert enjoy going to the beach to collect shells. On Monday, Kylie collects 5 more shells than Robert, who collects 20 shells. On Tuesday, Kylie collects 2 times more shells than she did on Monday and Robert collects 39 shells. How many shells does Kylie collect on Tuesday?
Maggie used up one-fourth of her funds, and Riza used up one-third of her funds. Both of them initially had $60. What is the remaining amount of money they both have?

The age of Brandon's iPhone is quadruple that of Ben's iPhone. Meanwhile, Ben's iPhone has been around for twice as long as Suzy's iPhone. Given that Suzy's iPhone has been in use for 1 year, can you determine the age of Brandon's iPhone?
The area of Billie's rectangular bedroom is 360 square feet. What is the perimeter of the room in feet?

A customs officer at the main port of SeaSide clearances counted 2 containers of imported vehicles, each having 5 vehicles inside. The next day, more containers were brought in. Calculate the number of containers that were imported on the second day, assuming all the containers contain 5 vehicles.

Ellen is on a diet. She eats two carrots, a salad, and a yogurt every day. The salad costs her $6, while the yogurt is half the price. Alan has a $2 coupon but finds it expired. How much does Ellen pay for one carrot every day when in total she pays $11 for her goods?

A council met to vote on a new regulation. The vote passed with twice as many votes in favor of the new regulation as there were against it. If there are 33 people on the council, 15 of them are women, what was the number of votes in favor of the new regulation?

Two girls each got 1/6 of the 24 liters of water, even though they initially asked for 2 liters each. Then a boy, who was previously given 3 liters but returned it, got 6 liters of water. How many liters of water were left?
Mia and Emma are currently 16 years apart in age. What's the average of their ages?

Mark is employed in a job where he works for 8 hours daily for a span of 5 days each week. His initial hourly wage was $10, but it has been increased by $2. What is the total amount of money he earns in a week now?

James delivers 600 newspapers in a day, 200 of which are English-language newspapers. He delivers 198 newspapers to District A, some to District B, and 209 newspapers to District C. How many newspapers does he deliver to District B?

Jake is walking through the Museum of Entomology. He sees some spiders with 8 legs each, 90 insects with 6 legs each, and 3 rare mutant invertebrates with 10 legs each. How many legs does Jake see in total?

It takes 240 minutes of walking to break in a new pair of shoes. Jason wants to try out for the track team in three weeks. If he can walk 4 days a week to break in the new shoes and the other 3 days to wear old shoes, how long does he have to spend walking each day?
A fruit vendor bought 50 watermelons for $80 and 30 apples for $30. He sold all of them at a profit of 25%. How much was each watermelon sold?

Melissa is called for jury service. She dedicates 6 hours each day for a span of 3 days to a legal case. Melissa receives a daily payment of $15, but she also incurs a daily parking fee of $3. What is Melissa's hourly earnings from jury service after deducting her expenses?

Rita hand-picks June worms from her plants every summer. On Monday, she removed 39 June worms. On both Tuesday and Wednesday, she removed twice as many June bugs as she did on Monday. She removed 48 on Thursday and 57 on Friday. What is the average number of June bugs she removes each day?

At the beginning of November, both Ginger and Amy have 100 pieces of Halloween sweets each. Every day, Ginger consumes 4 sweets while Amy only eats 3. After a fortnight, how many more sweets does Amy have compared to Ginger?
In a candy machine, there are 22 more than four times the number of pink gumballs as there are blue gumballs. If there are 12 blue gumballs,  each worth $2, how many pink ones are there?
John rents his car out 10 times a month. He gets paid $25 an hour. If his car payment is $500, how much profit does he make on his car?

The ratio of men to women on a car is 2:1. The ratio of men to women on a bus is 5:9. If the total number of passengers on the bus is 84, and 20 women alight from the bus at the next stop, how many women have remained on the bus?

A hand-painted wallpaper costs $400 and a regular wallpaper costs $100 at the market. A DIY will save 20% after considering the materials' cost. If Ethan made his own hand-painted wallpaper, how much was the total cost?
During a school event, there are fifty-four participants who need to be divided into six equally sized teams. If the event calls for 12 teams in total, how many additional teams need to be created?

You need wait in line for 10 minutes make a call. To make a call from a payphone, you must pay $0.25 for each minute of your call. After 16 minutes, that price drops to $0.2 per minute. How much would a 36-minute call cost?

At their lemonade stand, Julie, Micah, and Mitchell managed to sell 32 glasses of lemonade. Julie was able to sell 14 glasses, while the remaining glasses were sold equally by the two boys. What is the difference in the number of glasses sold by Julie and Micah?

For a period of 14 days, Paul has been operating his car two times daily: once in the AM and once in the PM. Each AM drive sets him back approximately $6, while each PM drive costs him around $2. Can you calculate the total amount of money Paul has expended on his car rides over these two weeks?

On average, Joe throws 25 punches per minute. A boxing match lasts 5 rounds of 3 minutes each. In between each round, there is a 1-minute break where Joe drinks 200ml of water but doesn't throw any punches. How many punches did he throw during the fight?

John has a pool that is 6 feet long, 4 feet wide, and 5 feet deep. He also has a separate hot tub that is 3 feet by 3 feet and 2 feet deep, but he decides not to fill it up today. The cost to fill the pool is $.1 per cubic foot. How much does it cost to fill the pool?

A robe takes 2 bolts of blue fiber and half that much white fiber. If each bolt of fiber costs $5 but there's a special discount today that reduces the price of each bolt by $2, how many bolts in total does it take to make the robe?
James decided to walk to the store. When he got halfway there he realized he forgot something at home and had to walk back. If he walks 4 miles per hour how long did it take him to reach the store?
The light on a lighthouse blinks 255 times. How long will it take the light to blink 459 times?

Trinity sells magazines at 11/8 of the price she bought them. She also sells bookmarks at $2 each, but the cost of the bookmarks does not affect her overall profit. If she bought the magazines at $72 and sold 50 bookmarks, what is her profit from selling the magazines?

Mike bought 5 face masks and a bottle of hand sanitizer. Johnny, on the other hand, bought 2 more face masks than thrice the number of face masks Mike bought, along with a pack of gloves. How many face masks did Johnny buy?

Bubbles collects stuffed animals. She has three stuffed puppies, five stuffed koalas, two stuffed zebras and four stuffed frogs. If she wants to buy enough stuffed goats, how many stuffed goats should she buy?

Damien established a monetary system using bottle caps and involved his friends in it. He collects 10 bottle caps daily on his journey back home, with each bottle cap valued at $.25. What is the total amount of money he accumulates in a month of 30 days?
My kitchen floor has a total area. I want to install new square floor tiles that cost $12 each, and each tile side is 1ft in length. How much will it cost me to renovate my kitchen floor?
